visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a metal strainer containing white rice and black beans held over a pink pot on an induction cooktop. White text instructions are overlaid at the top. (2) A high-angle shot shows a white plastic container filled with peeled, cubed orange sweet potatoes soaking in water. (3) Hands pour olive oil into a white ceramic pot, followed by the rice and grain mixture. The kitchen is brightly lit with a clean, modern aesthetic. (4) Water is poured from a stainless steel pitcher into the pot. Hands carefully place the sweet potato chunks on top of the rice before covering the pot with a pink lid. (5) The scene cuts to a black pan where minced garlic and wood ear mushrooms are being sautéed. Steam rises visibly from the hot surface. (6) A large amount of chopped green cabbage is added to the pan. A black spatula is used to toss the vegetables quickly. (7) Mung bean sprouts and sliced green onions are added to the stir-fry mixture. The camera remains focused on the pan's contents. (8) The pink lid is lifted from the rice pot, revealing the cooked sweet potato grains. A white spatula fluffs the rice, showing its soft texture. (9) A whole red fish, coated in white flour, is placed into a frying pan with oil. The camera captures the golden-brown crust as the fish is flipped. (10) The finished fish is plated on a white dish, and a hand grinds black pepper over it. (11) The final shot displays a partitioned tray with the completed meal, including the fish, sweet potato rice, and stir-fried vegetables.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 地瓜雜糧飯. [Subtitle]: 地瓜跟米白米泡30分鐘. (2) [Subtitle]: 日本16穀米 一包30克. (3) [Subtitle]: 水量 1:1 外加 70ml 的水. (4) [Subtitle]: 15ml 味醂. (5) [Slogan]: 把地瓜擺上來. (6) [Subtitle]: 鍋子裡加入一點橄欖油. (7) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾水分. (8) [Subtitle]: 一小撮鹽 提升地瓜甜味. (9) [Subtitle]: 15ml味醂 讓米飯更好吃！(可省略). (10) [Subtitle]: 先煮滾，然後轉小火. (11) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋，煮13分鐘 悶15分鐘. (12) [Slogan]: 炒高麗菜. [Subtitle]: 先炒洋蔥末跟高麗菜梗. (13) [Subtitle]: 再放木耳片. (14) [Subtitle]: 炒高麗菜加上一些洋蔥會更鮮甜！ (15) [Slogan]: 放入高麗菜囉～❤️. [Subtitle]: (炒高麗菜請看之前影片示範). (16) [Slogan]: 我喜歡再放一些豆芽菜❤️. (17) [Slogan]: 快速的拌炒均勻. (18) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、胡椒調味. (19) [Subtitle]: 最後加一些蒜末跟蔥花. (20) [Slogan]: 拌炒均勻就可以起鍋了. (21) [Slogan]: 超好吃的 家常炒高麗菜 就完成啦～❤️. (22) [Slogan]: 地瓜雜糧米飯也煮好了～❤️. (23) [Slogan]: 好吃～❤️. (24) [Slogan]: 鬆一下飯～❤️. (25) [Slogan]: 地瓜鬆軟好吃，米飯也好吃～❤️. (26) [Subtitle]: 煎魚我喜歡簡單鹽調味. [Subtitle]: 表面拍一些地瓜粉 夾來煎～. (27) [Subtitle]: 可以煎出脆脆的外皮 魚肉又很嫩！❤️. (28) [Subtitle]: 確認一下有沒有煎出焦香. (29) [Subtitle]: 再翻面. (30) [Slogan]: 鍋子傾斜一下 就翻過來囉～. (31) [Subtitle]: 另外一面也煎出焦香. [Slogan]: 煎魚超級簡單！✅. (32) [Subtitle]: 裹粉煎除了魚肉保水之外. (33) [Subtitle]: 還有一個好處就是 不太噴油！很好清理✅. (34) [Slogan]: 起鍋前用廚房紙巾把油吸掉. (35) [Slogan]: 慢慢倒出來... (36) [Subtitle]: 表面撒上胡椒 也可擠上檸檬... (37) [Slogan]: 簡單家常煎魚就完成啦！✅. [Subtitle]: 只要魚新鮮，簡單調味就好吃！❤️. (38) [Slogan]: 今日餐點. [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. (39) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG. [Slogan]: 臉書：羅潔塔的廚房. [Slogan]: YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A gentle, lyrical solo piano melody begins. The tone is bright and clear, set in a major key with a moderate tempo. No speech or ambient noise is present. (2) A soft metallic cascading sound occurs as dry rice is poured into a pot, accompanied by the constant, soothing piano background music. (3) A distinct, broadband sizzling sound begins as oil and ingredients hit the hot pan. The acoustic texture is sharp and consistent, like white noise. (4) The sound of liquid turbulence is heard as water is poured from a pitcher. The piano track maintains a steady volume and harmonic progression underneath. (5) Intermittent metallic clinking sounds are audible as a spatula stir-fries vegetables. The sizzling sound fluctuates in intensity but remains a prominent background layer. (6) A short, bright digital 'bubble' sound effect triggers a transition. The piano melody continues uninterrupted, providing a calm tonal framework. (7) A deep, continuous crackling sizzle starts as a large fish is fried. The sound has high spectral density and masks some of the softer piano frequencies. (8) A mechanical clicking and crunching sound occurs as pepper is ground onto the dish. The piano music begins to slowly fade out into silence as the presentation ends.
